name: Jenkins Remote API
tagline: Remote REST/JSON API for Jenkins CI servers
description: Jenkins exposes a Remote Access API on every object, allowing developers and automation tools to query jobs, builds, nodes, and system state, and to trigger builds over HTTP. It is server-local (each Jenkins instance hosts its own API), typically returning JSON or XML, and commonly authenticated with API tokens or username/password. As self-hosted software, pricing and rate limits are instance-specific rather than SaaS-wide.

auth.details: API token or username:password via HTTP Basic Auth (or crumb + session for CSRF-protected POSTs); configured per Jenkins instance, not a global SaaS key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted; no SaaS free-tier quotas — limits depend on your Jenkins instance
pricing.paid_plans: Jenkins core is free/open source; commercial support available via CloudBees and other vendors

use_cases: list jobs and their last build status on a Jenkins instance
fetch build console log or build metadata by job name
check queue and executor status for CI capacity
get Jenkins version and system info from the root API
